'''King Ozz's Personal Estate''' was one of the homes of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ozz (Ugnaught)/Legends|Ozz]] located on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]]. It had a Skimmer Racing Center attached to it.<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
